6:5: The fire on the altar shall be kindled with it; it shall not go out.
The kohein shall burn logs upon it each and every morning
and arrange the burnt-offering on it
and burn upon it the fats of the sacred-offering.
6:8: He shall separate from it, when he takes his fistful, from some of the meal-offerings fine flour and some of its oil
He shall burn, on the altar to be accepted with favor; its memorial portion, before Adonoy.
6:10: It should not be baked [as] leavened.
I have given it to them as their portion from my offerings.
It is holy of holies [most holy],
as [are] the sin-offering and as the guilt-offering.
6:11: Every male descendant of Aharon may eat it,
an everlasting statute for all your descendants
whatever shall touch them will become sacred.
6:13: This is the offering of Aharon and his sons that they shall offer before Adonoy on the day that he is inaugurated to greatness;
one tenth of three se’in of fine flour as a meal-offering, always [daily].
Half of it [he shall offer] in the morning
and half of it [he shall offer] in the evening.
6:14: In a frying pan, with oil it shall be made; you shall bring it saturated,
well-baked, a meal-offering of broken pieces,
you shall bring it to be accepted with favor before Adonoy.
6:15: The kohein who is inaugurated to greatness in his stead from among his sons, he shall [also] do it;
an everlasting statute before Adonoy, it shall be entirely burnt.
6:19: The kohein who atones with its blood, shall eat it.
It shall be eaten in a sacred place,
in the Courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.
7:3: He shall separate all its fat from it;
7:5: The kohein shall burn them on the altar,
7:9: Every meal-offering that shall be baked in an oven
and every one made in a deep pot which appears as if it has been ploughed out or frying pan,
[belong] to the kohein who offers it; it shall belong to him.
7:10: Every meal-offering mixed with oil or not mixed,
shall belong to all the sons of Aharon, each equally.
7:11: This is the law of the sacred-offering
7:14: From it, he shall bring one from each offering
To that kohein who sprinkles the blood of the sacred-offering, it shall belong to him.
7:15: on the day of its sacrifice it may be eaten.
He shall not leave over any of it until morning.
7:18: If it will be eaten, of the flesh of the sacred-offering on the third day, it will not be favorably accepted.
[As to] whoever brings it, it will not be credited to him; it is rejected
and anyone who eats of it shall bear [the burden of] its iniquity.
7:19: The flesh of the sacred offerings that will touch any unclean [thing] may not be eaten;
it shall be burned in fire.
[As to] the sacred flesh, every person fitting for the sacred may eat sacred meat.
7:20: The person who eats of the flesh of the sacred-offering which is before Adonoy
while his uncleanness is yet on him,
that persons soul shall be cut off from its people.
7:21: A person who touches anything unclean, be it the impurities of man or an unclean animal, or any unclean creeping creature
and then eats some flesh of the sacred-offering which is before Adonoy,
that persons soul shall be cut off from its people.
7:25: of an animal from which is offered an offering before Adonoy,
the person who ate it shall be cut off from its people.
7:27: Any person who eats any blood,
that person shall be cut off from its people.
7:29: Whoever shall bring the sacrifice of his sacred-offering before Adonoy,
he shall bring his offering before Adonoy from his sacred-offering.
7:30: he shall bring the fat on the breast
and the breast [itself] to lift them up as an uplifted-offering before Adonoy.
7:32: you shall give as a separated portion to the kohein,
7:33: Whoever offers the blood of the sacred-offering and the fat who is of the sons of Aharon,
the right thigh shall belong to him as a portion.
7:34: Because the breast uplifted-offering and the thigh [that is] the separated portion I have taken from Bnei Yisroel.
and I have given them to Aharon the kohein and to his sons,
as an everlasting statute, from Bnei Yisroel.
7:35: This is [for] the inauguration to greatness of Aharon and [for] the inauguration to greatness of his sons
on the day He brought them
7:36: that Adonoy commanded to give to them, on the day He inaugurated them to greatness,
an everlasting statute for all their descendants.
7:37: This is the law for the burnt-offering, the meal-offering,
7:38: that Adonoy commanded Moshe on Mount Sinai,
on the day that he commanded Bnei Yisroel to bring their offerings before Adonoy in the desert of Sinai.
8:2: the bull for the sin-offering, the two rams
8:10: Moshe took the oil of inaugurating to greatness
and inaugurated the Tabernacle to greatness and everything inside it
8:11: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times;
he inaugurated to greatness the altar and all its utensils, the washing basin and its base, to sanctify them.
8:12: He poured some of the anointing-oil which inaugurates to greatness
and inaugurated him to greatness, to sanctify him.
8:21: He washed the innards and feet in water;
and Moshe burned the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt-offering; to be accepted with favor, an offering before Adonoy,
8:22: and Aharon and his sons laid their hands on the rams head.
8:23: and Moshe took some of its blood
and he put it on the upper part of Aharons right ear,
on the thumb of his right hand
and the big toe of his right foot.
8:24: He brought the sons of Aharon; and Moshe put some blood on the upper part of their right ears
and on the thumbs of their right hands
and on the big toes of their right feet.
Moshe sprinkled the blood all around the altar.
8:27: and on the palms of his sons
and he lifted them up as an uplifted-offering before Adonoy.
8:28: Moshe took them from their palms
and he burned them on the altar in addition to the burnt-offering;
they are offerings to be accepted with favor,
8:29: and lifted it up as an uplifted-offering before Adonoy.
From the ram for the offerings — that was the portion of Moshe —
8:30: Moshe took some oil which inaugurates to greatness and some blood that was on the altar
and sprinkled it on Aharon, on his garments,
and on his sons and on his sons garments with him.
He sanctified Aharon and his garments
and his sons and his sons garments with him.
8:31: Moshe said to Aharon and to his sons Cook the flesh at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
and you shall eat it there
[with] the bread that is in the basket of sacrifices
Aharon and his sons shall eat them.
8:33: From the entrance of the Tent of Meeting you shall not go out for seven days
8:35: At the entrance of the Tent of Meeting you shall sit day and night for seven days
and keep the charge of the Word of Adonoy and you will not die,
because I have been thus commanded.
